_note: Names from SRM's application portal and college sites. Fees = annual tuition in ₹ for the Kattankulathur campus, from SRM's "Admissions 2026" programme tables (srmist.edu.in/admission-india/…, read 2026-10-25); a one-time registration fee and exam fees are extra. B.B.A., B.Sc., B.C.A. and B.A. are 3 years, with an optional 4th (Honours) year under NEP. Durations: from SRM pages where cited, otherwise the statutory/standard length for the degree (B.Tech 4, M.Tech 2, MBA 2, B.Arch 5, integrated LL.B. 5, B.Pharm 4, Pharm.D 6, B.Sc. Nursing 4). outcomes = typical career paths for the discipline, NOT SRM placement claims. Engineering also runs at Ramapuram, Vadapalani, Delhi NCR and Tiruchirappalli — TODO: map per-programme campus availability.
